# Ducklab

> Multi-LLM development harness: brief → requirements → spec → plan → build →
> review → release, with real verification gates. Local-first (llama.cpp,
> vLLM, any OpenAI-compatible or Anthropic endpoint), self-hosted, no
> telemetry. Core rule: no model ever decides a verdict — a verdict is a
> command's exit code, accepts re-prove themselves from a clean checkout, and
> everything is bounded and recorded. Ducklab is developed inside ducklab;
> the run records in .ducklab/ are the receipts. Apache-2.0, Go + React
> (Wails desktop), Linux first.

Key facts: three binaries (engine daemon on loopback, CLI client, desktop
client); five run modes (solo, pair, tournament, split, council); seats held
by "ducklings" ranked on measured evidence from your own runs; skills
(SKILL.md directories, documentation-first); reference documents with
automatic digestion when the corpus exceeds a seat's context window; an MCP
server so another agent can operate the entire loop with recorded,
attributed decisions.

- [Decisions](docs/decisions/): where code and spec deliberately differ, and why
- [OpenAPI](docs/openapi.json): the engine's full HTTP contract, generated from the route table
- [Status](docs/status.md): every acceptance criterion, honestly graded
